claims.claim_text: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, defining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths for regulated financial clients.
Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing usage-based subscription forecasting with partner-led deal support to expand recurring revenue.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through context engineering, evaluation gates, and rollback controls that hardened production reliability.
Standardized the production AI adoption lifecycle with replayable runtime design and exit disposition governance, compressing the lifecycle from six months to three weeks.

Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, combining Databricks Lakehouse pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design and provider egress governance.
Led AI platform commercialization and operating model design that scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while converting bespoke delivery into reusable productized IP.
